offer.headline: A custom website for your business, built and maintained for you.
offer.subhead: One setup fee, one low monthly price. We design it, host it, and keep it up to date, so you can get back to running your business.
offer.priceNote: No long-term contract. Cancel any month.

promises.firstVersion: usually about a week after we have your information and payment
promises.edits: usually done in 2 to 3 business days
promises.cancellation: Cancel any month. Your site stays online until the end of that month.

leadForm.consentText: By submitting, you agree that {partnerName} may contact you by text or email about this offer. Message and data rates may apply. You can opt out at any time.
